title: Voltmeter Reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the secondary voltage as 110 V using the transformer voltage ratio.

title: Ammeter Reading
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the primary current as 1 A using the transformer current ratio.

title: Input Power Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the input power as 220 W using primary voltage and current.

title: RMS Voltage Identification
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly convert the given peak voltage to RMS (220 V) before applying transformer formulas.

title: Ohm's Law Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Ohm's law to find the secondary current (2 A) before using the current ratio.

title: Transformer Ratio Direction
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student reverses the voltage or current ratio formulas (e.g., U1/U2 = n2/n1).

title: Peak vs RMS Confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses the peak voltage (220√2 V) directly in calculations without converting to RMS.

title: Power Conservation Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student may verify power conservation by comparing primary input power (220 W) with secondary output power (I2²R = 220 W).
